newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES TRADE NERVOUSLY AHEAD OF RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES TRADE NERVOUSLY AHEAD OF RESULTS.

text.p: Danish share prices were lower in mid-morning trade on Wednesday in a nervous market cautiously awaiting key corporate results.
"The market looks like being mixed and jittery up to the day's three key results," one dealer said.
First-half results from Novo Nordisk and SAS are expected on Wednesday as well as full year 1996/97 results from B&O.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.36 point to 184.19 at 0825 GMT, having closed 0.54 down on Tuesday.
